About Us

Little Explorer is a professional educational application designed to help children discover the world around them in a fun and safe way. Built with love for the next generation of explorers.

Privacy Policy

1. Data Storage

All student profiles, scores, and activity logs are stored locally on your device. We do not transmit child progress to our servers.

2. Child Safety

The app is 100% compliant with COPPA regulations. There are no chat rooms or social features that could expose children to external risks.

3. Advertising

We use family-policy compliant ads from Google AdMob. These ads are filtered to ensure they are age-appropriate.

4. Parental PIN

The parent dashboard and settings are locked behind a 4-digit PIN to prevent accidental changes by children.
